description: Linux kernel driver source code for Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA, including firmware handling, DMA, and hardware initialization functions.

methods.name: dc_aca_init
methods.description: Initializes the ACA hardware, loads firmware, and sets up DMA and other configurations.

methods.name: dc_aca_start
methods.description: Starts ACA functions based on provided bitmask and optionally triggers hardware start.

methods.name: dc_aca_stop
methods.description: Stops ACA functions, optionally resets hardware, and checks for pending jobs.

methods.name: dc_aca_info_init
methods.description: Initializes internal ACA info structure, including max GPIO detection.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_sub_ack
methods.description: Writes acknowledgment value to the TXIN sub address.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_hd_cnt
methods.description: Reads the current count of TXIN HD.

methods.name: aca_umt_msg_addr
methods.description: Returns the UMT message address based on endianness and type.

methods.name: dc_aca_event_addr_get
methods.description: Fills in the ACA event register addresses.

methods.name: dc_aca_shutdown
methods.description: Resets and disables ACA hardware functions.
